description: Add opt-in JSON file persistence to ControlRegistry, PhaseMachine, and LayeredMemoryStore (L2/L3). All three modules use the same atomic write pattern (write to temp file, os.replace to target). Persistence is opt-in via persist_path parameter - when None, behavior is unchanged (backward compatible).
steps: Modify src/nexus/governance/control_registry.py: Add optional persist_path: Path | None parameter to __init__. After every mutation method (pause, pause_auto_delivery, gate_tool, steer, halt, resume, clear_steers), call a _persist() method that serializes self._map to JSON and writes atomically (tempfile in same dir + os.replace). On init, if persist_path exists, load state from it. AgentControl.gated_tools is a set - serialize as sorted list, deserialize back to set.

Modify src/nexus/orchestration/phase_machine.py: Add optional persist_path: Path | None parameter to __init__. After every mutation (state changes in check_plan_detected, approve_plan, check_final_result, handle_user_feedback, reset), call _persist(). Serialize self._phases as {str(uuid): phase_value}. On init, if persist_path exists, load and reconstruct UUID keys.

Modify src/nexus/memory/layered.py: Add optional persist_path: Path | None parameter to __init__. Persist only L2 and L3 (L0/L1 remain ephemeral). After mutations in store_fact and promote_to_shared, call _persist(). Serialize Facts as dicts with ISO timestamps and str UUIDs. On init, if persist_path exists, load L2/L3.

Add tests in tests/test_persistence.py covering: (1) ControlRegistry saves/loads state correctly with persist_path, (2) ControlRegistry without persist_path works as before, (3) PhaseMachine saves/loads state correctly, (4) PhaseMachine without persist_path works as before, (5) LayeredMemoryStore persists L2/L3 but not L1, (6) LayeredMemoryStore without persist_path works as before, (7) Atomic write safety (file not corrupted on error), (8) Missing file on init creates fresh state.
Verify existing tests still pass: python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_control_registry.py tests/test_phase_machine.py tests/test_layered_memory.py -q
acceptance_criteria: ControlRegistry(persist_path=Path('/tmp/test.json')) saves state after each mutation and loads on init
PhaseMachine(persist_path=Path('/tmp/test.json')) saves state after each mutation and loads on init
All three modules work identically when persist_path=None (backward compatible)
All existing tests (2276) continue to pass
findings: All 2299 tests pass (23 new + 2276 existing). Python 3.12 available at /usr/bin/python3.12. pip install -e '.[dev]' must use python3.12 -m pip. The get_agent_facts method increments access_count, so freshly loaded facts will show access_count=1 after first retrieval.
